readings: The condition wave==31 (or wave==0) is evaluated on the current register value, so wave stays at 31 and 0 for two consecutive clock cycles each.
The condition is evaluated on the next incremented/decremented value, so wave stays at 31 and 0 for only one clock cycle each.
After reset deasserts, state=0 and wave=0, so the first clock edge increments wave to 1; the initial 0 lasts only for the reset cycle.
After reset deasserts, the module must hold wave at 0 for one extra clock cycle before incrementing, matching the steady-state two-cycle hold at 0.
